reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Content-Type Auto-Detection: In v3, the `Content-Type` header is not auto-detected anymore when it is not set by the backend", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Responses whose backend does not set Content-Type no longer get an auto-detected Content-Type header unless the ContentType middleware is used.
consequence.remediation: Use the ContentType middleware to enable Content-Type auto-detection.

proposed.statement: In v3, Traefik no longer auto-detects the Content-Type header when the backend doesn't set it; the ContentType middleware must be used to enable auto-detection.
